英文作文（30 分）Unsafe drivers can be of any age, particularly when drinking is involved.While younger drivers may be inexperienced or more likely to bedistracted or reckless, older drivers often overestimate their drivingabilities. That may be one reason many unsafe older drivers continue todrive despite failing driving skills. Balancing public safety with seniors’independence is a complex issue. Support your argument with clear reasoning, and if possible,real-life examples.

mcq.q: Which of the following sentences best expresses the main idea of the first paragraph?
opts: Microbeads are contaminating waterways in a harmful manner.
Microbeads are appearing in the tap water people use every day.
Microbeads are a clever design to cleanse the pores and remove surface stains from teeth.
Microbeads are clogging up the bathroom drains and wastewater treatment systems.
mcq.passage: If you are a person who cares about hygiene, you may have noticed little beads in exfoliating facial scrubs and toothpaste. What you may not know is that these microbeads are actually balls of plastic that are smaller than five millimeters in diameter. They were designed to be easily flushed down the drain. However, because water treatment plants were not built to filter them out, microbeads are polluting rivers, oceans, and lakes in a serious yet not immediately obvious way. According to a study that was published in the scientific journal Environmental Science and Technology in 2015, eight trillion microbeads were released into aquatic habitats daily in the US alone. Since then, this estimate has continued to rise, contributing to the ever-growing global microplastic problem. Microbeads aren’t biodegradable, which is bad news for both marine life and humans. The microbeads function as sponges and end up attracting dangerous chemicals like pesticides. Some animals, such as fish, cannot distinguish the beads from good and wind up eating them. In turn, these same animals are then eaten by humans. As a result, these beads radically impact human health as they move from being chemicals in water to being part of the food chain. What’s worse is that because of their size, they are incredibly difficult to clean up. Using them has put us on a surefire path to harming the planet’s wildlife and water quality.“Beat the Microbead”is an international campaign initiated in 2012 by the Plastic Soup Foundation to raise the general public’s awareness about the environmental impact of microbeads. It has pressured cosmetic companies to phase out the use of beads. It has even released an app that allows people to scan the barcodes of products to see whether they contain microbeads. Identifying the complex names in an ingredients list can be difficult for consumers. However, the best solution at hand is to ban the use of microbeads outright and figure out a way to clean our oceans. Another way is to adopt natural alternatives that are non-toxic and biodegradable to replace microbeads. Researchers of the study concluded, “The probability of risk from microbead pollution is high, while the solution to this problem is simple.”

mcq.q: What is the writer’s purpose in the first paragraph?
opts: To describe the financial advantages of using AI agents over human employees
To explain the technical capabilities of AI agents like Ava in sales-related tasks
To provide an example of a startup benefiting from AI by offering virtual sales representatives
To illustrate the growing concern about AI’s potential to replace human workers in the job market
mcq.passage: The impact of artificial intelligence on employment is a prominent topic, as highlighted by a sign reading “Stop Hiring Humans” at an AI conference, reflecting the unease surrounding new AI models. Artisan, a startup, exemplifies this shift by offering AI agents like Ava, virtual sales representatives that can identify leads, contact customers, write emails, and schedule appointments, costing 96 percent less than human equivalents. This development is part of the generative AI trend that began with ChatGPT in 2022, where AI increasingly makes decisions traditionally made by humans. While Artisan, one of the key players in this field, is upfront about the possibility of AI replacing certain jobs, many other generative AI companies take a more cautious stance. These companies argue that rather than replacing workers, AI will primarily serve as a tool to enhance human capabilities, allowing individuals to perform their jobs more efficiently and creatively. Predictions regarding AI's impact vary significantly. Goldman Sachs estimates 300 million potential job losses globally. A Metrigy report indicated that 89 percent of surveyed firms reduced customer relations staff due to generative AI. Conversely, the World Economic Forum found that 70 percent of major companies plan to hire workers with AI-related skills. This is seen by some as a“natural evolution,”with new sectors and jobs being created while others are lost, similar to the impact of the car. US Department of Labor data shows a decline in secretarial roles and a rise in computer scientists, coinciding with the rise of office computing. Given the potential for displacement, some advise discretion when promoting AI that replaces parts of a team, with some clients preferring to keep their AI usage confidential. Analysts predict job losses for roles like programmers, call center operators, translators, and travel agents. However, some startups argue that their AI focuses on revenue growth, which can lead to more human jobs. Others note that while companies may not want to lay off staff, they are looking to grow without additional hiring. Transparency about AI's implications is crucial to avoid public backlash, as the development of AI is considered by some to be“inevitable.”

To provide contrasting viewpoints on whether AI will take over jobs or serve as a tool to assistworkers
To argue that AI will inevitably replace jobs in industries like sales and customer service
To provide a historical overview of how generative AI evolved, beginning with the launch ofChatGPT

This is seen by some as a“natural evolution,”with new sectors and jobs being created while others are lost, similar to the impact of the car. US Department of Labor data shows a decline in secretarial roles and a rise in computer scientists, coinciding with the rise of office computing. Given the potential for displacement, some advise discretion when promoting AI that replaces parts of a team, with some clients preferring to keep their AI usage confidential. Analysts predict job losses for roles like programmers, call center operators, translators, and travel agents. However, some startups argue that their AI focuses on revenue growth, which can lead to more human jobs. Others note that while companies may not want to lay off staff, they are looking to grow without additional hiring. Transparency about AI's implications is crucial to avoid public backlash, as the development of AI is considered by some to be“inevitable.”
